chunks: Those who do not believe and obstruct others from the way of God, and die disbelieving, will not be pardoned by God.
ai.seo_question: Who will not be forgiven by God according to Surah Muhammad?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Muhammad (47:34) underscores the finality of divine pardon for those who persist in kufr and actively hinder others from the path of God. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of 'sadd al-sabil' (blocking the way), highlighting that active obstruction compounds the severity of disbelief. The verse serves as a warning that mere belief is insufficient if one impedes the spread of divine guidance.
